_meta.title: Indigenous imprisonment rates by state, Australia, 2025
_meta.what: How many Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander adults are in prison per 100,000, compared with non-Indigenous adults, in each state and territory, at 30 June 2025, plus the yearly age-standardised rates for 2016-2025.
_meta.source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Prisoners in Australia 2025, data cube 2 (Tables 17 and 19)
_meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 ("All material presented on this website is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0")
_meta.boundaries: ABS ASGS Edition 3 States and Territories 2021 (CC BY 4.0), simplified; Other Territories omitted (no prison data)
_meta.citation: Australian Bureau of Statistics (2025), Prisoners in Australia, ABS, CC BY 4.0
_meta.notes: All Table 17 cells kept as published, with keys "t17: section | sex | group". "np" = not published by ABS. Rates are per 100,000 adults of that group. Ratio = Indigenous rate / non-Indigenous rate. National (Aust.) figures in national_values.
